sources.quote: Epsilon Leporis, Latinized from ε Leporis, formally named Ping, is a third-magnitude star in the southern constellation Lepus.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 406 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,089 K, so 40.184 solar radii.
